🔴 How Does HMPV Spread?
Just like COVID, HMPV spreads through infected droplets.
🤧 Coughing & sneezing
🤝 Close contact with an infected person
🏠 Shared surfaces

🚨 Precaution is key!
Avoid crowded places and keep a distance from anyone
